profile.name: Aaron Kankipati
profile.currentRole: Senior Digital Product Manager, Wells Fargo (Hyderabad)
profile.summary: Senior Digital Product Manager with 7 years in digital banking and fintech. Currently leading core banking migration at Wells Fargo — improved platform availability from 99.9% to 99.999%, cutting downtime from 8.7 hours/year to under 6 minutes. Previously owned the Small Business Digital Deposit Application end-to-end: cut onboarding from 18 to 9 minutes, achieved 66.5% fully digital completion rate. Earlier delivered a COVID-era loan origination platform that disbursed ₹500 crore (~$60M) in its first year. Strong in regulated environments: change governance, release management, compliance, business readiness. Has independently shipped 4 live apps to Google Play and the web — including a monetised film recommender (Claude API + Play Billing + subscriptions), an autonomous trading simulator, a children's learning app (106 illustrated lessons, offline-first, Play Families certified), and a mobile arcade game (600+ assertion test suite).

profile.seniority: Senior / AVP / Lead level, 7+ years. NOT interested in junior, associate, intern, graduate, or entry-level roles.

preferences.values: Prefers regulated fintech / digital banking, genuine end-to-end product ownership, AI-focused products, and companies with a healthy culture. Values coaching, mentoring, and clear product accountability. Open to any domain for international sponsored roles.
preferences.dealbreakers: Pure delivery / project-management-only roles with no product ownership; heavy sales roles; junior or associate titles.
